name: wailing_caverns-extra
status: draft (the earlier offline record of the Disciple of Naralex event: its steps are now legs 12-20 of dungeons/wailing_caverns.json; this file is not for running)
notes: The Disciple of Naralex event of Wailing Caverns and what dungeons/wailing_caverns.json leaves out because the driver cannot do it yet. Do not run it as a plan: it is the record of the positions, entries and steps for the day the driver has the missing step types below. Mapped offline (world database export of map 43, src/scripts/dungeons/wailing_caverns/wailing_caverns.cpp and instance_wailing_caverns.cpp, script_waypoint 3678, gossip_menu 201/202); not walked live.

WHEN: after the four Fanglords (3671, 3669, 3670, 3673; Verdan and Skum are not needed) are dead. instance_wailing_caverns.cpp then sets the Disciple's default gossip menu to 202 and he yells (YELL_AFTER_GOSSIP). Before that his menu is 201 (text 698, gossip script 201 casts Mark of the Wild 5232 on the player). WHERE: the Disciple of Naralex (3678, faction 35, npc_flags 1, level 20, 1429 hp) stands at -134.965 125.402 -78.0945, 24 yd from the entrance point. The way back from Verdan is the long one (the hop in dungeons/wailing_caverns.json taken the other way: its landing -287.5 5.0 -63.6 up to the foot -293.3 0.5 -58.0, which the probe of 2026-10-18 showed cannot be climbed, tests/wc-hop-probe-2; then 1713 yd to the Disciple); it is not a leg here because the plan check walks the legs of a plan one after the other from the entrance. The live walk found that the hop cannot be walked back (the ramp side is 6 yd lower across a 3.9 yd gap with no floor: a jump down and an impossible climb up, and the navmesh has no link), so the way back to the Disciple is a gm_cross waypoint: the first leg below, escort_1, starts with a gm_cross via at the Disciple's stand, where a GM moves the party from behind Verdan (the alternative is the game's own shortcut, the waterfall hole behind Verdan, a drop into the river near the entrance, and the walk from the river).

STEP 1, the gossip (the step exists in turtle-agent pull request 194, feat/gossip-step, and is not in dev yet): option 0 of menu 202, 'Let the event begin!' (gossip_menu_option 202/0, condition 3678 = instance data TYPE_DISCIPLE is SPECIAL; the menu lags one update behind the last Fanglord's death, so retry_s is generous). Its script 202 is command 85 (send script event): OnScriptEventHappened starts the escort (npc_escortAI Start(false), no out-of-range check) and changes the Disciple to faction FACTION_ESCORT_N_NEUTRAL_ACTIVE. As a plan step: {"gossip": {"npc": 3678, "near": {"x": -134.965, "y": 125.402, "z": -78.0945}, "option": 0, "stand": {"x": -131.0, "y": 127.0, "z": -78.6}, "retry_s": 30, "fail_text": "the Disciple's menu 202 needs all four Fanglords dead"}}. It goes at the start of the first leg below (escort_1), where the leg's via point is the Disciple's stand.

STEP 2, the escort (31 script_waypoints, 3678 walks at speed_walk 1 and is attacked by what is summoned; if he dies his summons vanish (JustDied) and the escort is over; the script does not say whether it can be started again; Wowhead says it cannot until the instance resets and the four Fanglords are killed again): the party must stay with him and kill what comes. Stops: waypoint 0 at his spot (he says SAY_CAST_MARK and casts Mark of the Wild 5232 on every living player within 30 yd, 5 s); waypoint 7 (-102.4 232.8 -91.5): two Deviate Ravagers (3636, 'raptors') are summoned at -67.9 214.4 -93.5 and -69.8 211.3 -93.5 and run at him, then he talks 5 s; waypoint 15 (-54 276.2 -92.8): Serpentine Cleansing (6270, a 15 s cast, he is rooted and does not react to attacks while it runs) and three Deviate Vipers (5755) summoned at -52.9 269.8, -58.5 279.8 and -49.6 278.2 (z -92.8) after the cast; waypoint 26 (52.2 208.7 -89.5): a 3 s stop, SAY_BEFORE_CHAMBER; waypoint 30 (114.6 236.9 -96.0, facing Naralex 3679 at 115.4 240.0 -94.0): the ritual. He casts Sleep (1090) on one of his attackers every 30 s and drinks a potion (8141) below 80 percent hp.

STEP 3, the ritual at waypoint 30 (timers from the script, in seconds after he arrives): +1 SAY_BEFORE_RITUAL, +3 Naralex's Awakening 6271 (the Disciple is stunned by his own spell), +7 Naralex's emote, +12 three Deviate Moccasins (5762, level 20-21) summoned at Position[7..9] (123.8 271.9, 151.9 234.3, 127.6 200.8; z about -102), +52 seven Nightmare Ectoplasm (5763, level 20-21, faction 14, mechanic_immune_mask 64, immune to roots) at Position[3..9] (142.7 254.0, 140.5 219.8, 92.2 261.9, 100.3 268.6, 123.8 271.9, 151.9 234.3, 127.6 200.8), +92 Naralex speaks again, +102 Mutanus the Devourer (3654, level 22, 7944 hp, faction 270, EventAI 1720974-6) is summoned at Position[3] = 142.7 254.0 -102.2. Mutanus's spells: Naralex's Nightmare 7967 (interruptible), Terrify 7399, Thundercrack 8150; he has a school immunity mask of 32 (shadow). The summoned creatures run to the Disciple and attack him when they have no victim: the tank holds them, the others stay near him. When Mutanus dies (TYPE_MUTANUS DONE) every hostile of the instance that is alive or has no loot is despawned, and the script sets TYPE_DISCIPLE DONE: Naralex wakes, they speak (about 20 s) and fly away along 5 points, despawning (respawn 12 h). The loot (Mutanus drops the Glowing Shard, which starts a quest) stays on his corpse.

WOWHEAD (read with tools/wowhead/wh.py: the strategy guide 7843, the npc pages of Mutanus 3654 and the Disciple 3678 and their comments; data, the script wins): the escort is optional and unlocks when all four Fanglords are dead; protect the Disciple at all costs, if he dies or the group wipes the event fails and cannot be repeated until the instance resets; Mutanus is a group-composition check: Thundercrack (8150) hits everything near him hard (melee suffer, bring ranged and a second healer for it), Terrify (7399), and Naralex's Nightmare (7967, a shadow sleep: 'makes others evil and asleep', interruptible, see the tactics of the boss) are his spells; Mutanus is immune to shadow damage (a comment; his school_immune_mask 32 agrees); fight the waves with area damage (Arcane Explosion, totems, Frost Nova and Polymorph for the swarm) and keep the AoE damage dealers alive; clear the mobs on the way to Naralex's room beforehand; a comment counts five Nightmare Ectoplasm where the script summons seven, another that killing the slimes too fast can keep Mutanus from spawning (the script has a plain timer) and another that killing the waves too fast stalls Naralex's spell animation on a later realm, so let the Disciple be hit first: unverified. His loot includes the Glowing Shard, which starts a quest.

WHAT THE DRIVER CANNOT DO YET (2026-10-20: the event's steps are now legs 12-20 of dungeons/wailing_caverns.json, written with the step vocabulary dev has; this file's legs below stay as the earlier record and are not to be run): (1) the gossip step is in dev (dungeon.Gossip; the main plan's leg return_gossip takes option 0 of menu 202); (2) there is no step that walks WITH the escort NPC: the main plan's legs walk ahead to each of his stops and wait_for.unit pins the party there until he arrives (states seen, radius 8 to 9 yd round the stop), which is an approximation, not a walk at his side; (3) nothing waits for a summon inside a leg: the wave pulls sit in the legs after the waits, so a wave the script summons late is pulled only when its own leg's pull runs (the ritual waves ride the waits of the legs before); (4) summoned waves (the vipers, Moccasins, ectoplasm and Mutanus have no spawn rows) are modelled as pull groups and waits at the summon positions: the driver fights what the feed shows there; (5) the Disciple must live: no step marks an NPC as one to protect (the waits' fail_texts are the only witness); (6) a boss with several possible spawn spots (Lady Anacondra) and a way down by falling (the shortcut behind Verdan) have no step either, see the main plan.

legs.name: escort_1
notes: Starts with a gm_cross to the Disciple's stand (via 1 -131 127 -78.3: a GM moves the party there from behind Verdan), where the gossip step of the plan notes goes (option 0 of menu 202). Escort waypoint 7: SAY_1ST_WP, two Deviate Ravagers (3636) are SUMMONED (no spawn rows: the pull group is where they appear, then they run at the Disciple) at -67.9 214.4 -93.5 and -69.8 211.3 -93.5; the Disciple walks on 5 s after they are dead. A wait_for hostiles_gone (radius 35 around -68.8 212.9) would follow, but it passes at once while nothing is summoned yet.

legs.name: escort_2
notes: Escort waypoint 15 (-54 276.2 -92.8, Lady Anacondra's spot 4): the Disciple casts Serpentine Cleansing (15 s, rooted); the three Deviate Vipers (5755) are summoned at the group's positions when it ends, and he walks on when neither he nor the player who started the event is in combat.

legs.name: ritual
notes: Escort waypoint 26 (52.2 208.7 -89.5, a 3 s stop; via 1), then waypoint 30: the ritual (plan notes, step 3). Group 1 is the three Deviate Moccasins (+12 s), group 2 the seven Nightmare Ectoplasm (+52 s), both SUMMONED at Position[7..9] and Position[3..9] of the script (no spawn rows). Mutanus the Devourer (3654) is summoned at 142.7 254.0 -102.2 about 102 s after the Disciple arrives, so the boss position is the point where he appears; when he dies the event is done. A wait_for hostiles_gone (radius 45 around Naralex) cannot gate the waves on time: see the missing step types.
